cards.meaning: defense; the act of protecting someone or a side against an accusation
cards.example: Sinimulan ng pagtatanggol ang paglalahad ng kanilang ebidensiya sa Senado.
cards.exampleMeaning: The defense began presenting its evidence in the Senate.
cards.note: Mula sa 'tanggol'. Mas pormal kaysa sa hiram na 'depensa'; may kaugnay na 'tagapagtanggol'. May bigat ding emosyonal: 'ipinagtanggol niya ang pamilya'.
cards.tiesTo: Sara Duterte impeachment trial: defense begins its case

cards.meaning: verdict; judgment handed down after hearing the evidence
cards.example: Hihintayin natin ang hatol ng Senado.
cards.exampleMeaning: We will wait for the Senate's verdict.
cards.note: May bigat ng paghuhusga o parusa; mas mabigat kaysa 'pasya'. Ginagamit din sa 'hatol ng taumbayan' para sa paghuhusga ng mga botante.
cards.tiesTo: Senate sitting as impeachment court on Sara Duterte

cards.meaning: no wonder; it's little surprise that (result first, cause explains it)
cards.example: 上游成本涨了这么多,难怪工厂的利润被压缩了。
cards.examplePinyin: Shàngyóu chéngběn zhǎng le zhème duō, nánguài gōngchǎng de lìrùn bèi yāsuō le.
cards.exampleMeaning: Upstream costs have risen so much, so no wonder factories' margins have been squeezed.
cards.note: 连词/副词,中性偏书面;近义词'怪不得'更口语。难怪 says a puzzling result now makes sense; 当然 just says 'of course'.
cards.tiesTo: China: PPI 5.7% surge vs CPI 0.7% squeezes manufacturers

cards.meaning: to transmit / conduct; (economics) to pass through along a mechanism
cards.example: 上游成本很难传导到消费端。
cards.examplePinyin: Shàngyóu chéngběn hěn nán chuándǎo dào xiāofèi duān.
cards.exampleMeaning: Upstream costs are hard to pass through to the consumer end.
cards.note: 书面语,常见搭配:传导机制、价格传导。近义词'传递'更通用、偏口语,可指传话或传物;传导暗示有阻力的渠道。Written register; collocates with 机制 and 价格.
